title: Prescriptions Schedule of Restraint Days after Earlier Early Refills
content:
A Kestrel Prescriptions record that has already been refilled early carries the theft replacement restraint when a lost-or-stolen replacement is dispensed on it.

## Schedule

The theft replacement restraint counts the refills on the prescription in the last 12 months whose fill reason is vacation override, lost or stolen replacement, or dosage change:

| Such refills in the last 12 months | Days taken off the lost days |
|---|---|
| two or more | 7 |
| exactly one | 3 |
| none | nothing |

The lost days after the restraint are never below zero.

## Readings (hypothetical)

- One vacation override refill 4 months ago: 3 days taken off; lost days of 20 become 17.
- One dosage change refill and one lost or stolen replacement within the year: two, so 7 days taken off; lost days of 20 become 13.
- Lost days of 5 with 7 days taken off: never below zero, so 0.
- Routine refills are not counted.
